schema:name: Workers Hand Sorting Green Coffee Beans, Nicaragua
schema:description: This image shows workers manually sorting green coffee beans to separate inferior beans from quality beans. Hacienda La Minita, Distant Lands Coffee’s green coffee trading division, maintains relationships with specialty coffee producers, millers, and exporters around the world. In Nicaragua, Hacienda La Minita works with coffee farms and producer groups in coffee-growing regions including Jinotega and Matagalpa.
